diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 3 V, datasheet reading 3.3 V
diffs.evidence: Adafruit SCD-4x guide, Pinouts: 'VIN - This is the power pin. To power the board, give it the same power as the logic level of your microcontroller - e.g. for a 3V microcontroller like a Feather M4, use 3V, or for a 5V microcontroller like Arduino, use 5V.' The board's 3.3 V is the on-board regulator OUTPUT (3Vo), not the VIN minimum. Sensirion SCD4x datasheet v1.5 Table 4: 'Supply voltage DC VDD 2.4 min, 3.3 or 5.0 typ, 5.5 max V', so 3.3 V is the typical value, not a minimum; a 3 V VIN (minus small LDO drop) stays above the chip's 2.4 V minimum.
